name: EVA overexertion
source: Stahn et al. 2017 (core temperature can exceed 40 °C during exercise in space); sweat biomarker table (lactate, sodium ranges)
note: During heavy surface work (carrying solar panels) Mert overexerts and builds up heat. Target values are from the plan table. Once mandatory crew rest is ordered, heart rate, respiration, lactate and core temperature return to baseline.
